fit_reason: Whole 1985 runabout with trailer listed by a private owner in boats by owner.
findings: Dull, faded gelcoat along the port and starboard hull sides, especially the dark lower band
Brownish staining and grime near the waterline area on the hull sides

Grimy, dusty engine bay and oily-looking compartment under the engine hatch

message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 1985 Fabuglas runabout. The hull sides look faded with some staining near the waterline, and the vinyl seating and engine bay could use a good cleaning. We do pre-sale details and gelcoat polishing and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
